title: First Pakistani Astronaut Selected for Space Mission
excerpt: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has been chosen for China's Shenzhou-24 mission as Pakistan's first astronaut.
body_html: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has been officially selected to take part in China's Shenzhou-24 mission. This announcement marks a historic milestone for the country, as he becomes the first Pakistani astronaut to visit the Tiangong space station.
